description: Users who want to control who can send them direct messages must currently enable 'Only allow chat messages from users I follow'. During upgrade, accounts that previously enabled restrictChat are migrated by seeding the new allow list from the recipient's existing follow list (idempotent, safe to re-run).
f2p_test: test/messaging.js | Messaging Library .canMessageUser() should respect allow/deny list when sending chat messages
ablation_condition: Implement canMessageUser and settings permission checking, but completely omit src/upgrades/4.3.0/chat_allow_list.js
